About

An engineering background, applied to practical business

I studied Computer Science (BE CSE) and build websites with WordPress and React. Alongside that, I run and support several small ventures, from water treatment equipment to handmade gifts. I like solving practical problems and being transparent about what I can and can’t do.

Read my story

  • TransparencyClear scope, no inflated claims.
  • Practical executionWork that ships and works.
  • Continuous learningNew tools and ideas, applied carefully.
  • Customer focusBuilt around what people need.
